sources: Three new built-in image generations, 1672x941, plus the unchanged Road of Ashes braille scene

tests.routing: Native invocation uses controller; other themes, missing controller, and ordinary calls pass through
tests.cycles: 100 shuffled four-scene cycles verified with no boundary repeats
tests.barrier: Waits for active players, holds two seconds, removes a closed player
tests.artwork: Four unique scene contents; real ttfx rendering produces over 50 distinct character layouts per scene
tests.syntax: Python tests and bash syntax checks passed

desktop.matching_frames: Completed-scene captures on both monitors have identical SHA-256 hashes for all four scenes
desktop.dismissal: Escape dismissed both monitors; no ttfx processes remained
desktop.mouse: Native focus-based dismissal retained; physical mouse input was not independently automated
